Mati is the absolute best. We walked into Unleashed after impulse adopting a 9 week old megamutt (what I have now come to understand is rescue speak for “pitbull”). Mati could smell the fear on us as we wrangled Mr. Worldwide. Mati grabbed a cart and a new puppy checklist and took us throughout the store to make sure we got everything we needed for our first night. They told us about nutrition, training, and patiently waited as we weighed what we needed with what we could afford. 10/10 would definitely recommend shopping with Mati. We walked in dazed and confused and walked out grateful.

Beware - the prices in Petco stores are MUCH higher than listed on their website. The Purina Pro plan wet dog food cost $2.89 online was $3.49 in the store - 18% higher!! If you want to pay the lower price listed on the Petco website, be prepared to show the cashier proof at the check out so they will “match” their own lower online prices. Not a great way to run a business!

I recently had surgery and on Sept 8, 2025 a nice young woman helped me with buying my cats food and the a nice young man helped me carry my bags to my car. One of the nicest human interactions I’ve ever had the pleasure of experiencing I wish I wrote down their names to thank them personally. This store is a very nice local store.

There is only one shopping cart for the entire store. Nobody will assist you with purchases if you need help and are not able to access the one shopping cart. I was in there in the store had one other guest who was using the shopping cart no one else was in the store. And no one would help. The elderly lady who was using the cart was struggling to get her purchases in the back of her car and the manager stood inside and watched her. I was in the parking lot as I was waiting to use the shopping cart. Due to my medical issues, I was not able to assist this woman either but a stranger in the parking lot graciously did. Terrible customer service and lack of necessary, shopping carts. There are baskets, but you must be able to have the strength to lift the basket in order to use them, which I do not. I specifically asked the manager for help. He refused. The cashier was lovely with the manager needs some additional training in customer service. I do not recommend the store.

After your response, I contacted the number provided to me by you. This is obviously a call center that is out of our country. The girl that answered the phone was lovely, but she had never been asked to provide customer service in this regard. She had no idea what I was talking about. She asked me to explain what was going on. But I realized that she was not going to be able to address any of my issues whatsoever. As lovely as she was, this was a waste of my time. So if you really are concerned about customer satisfaction, provide us with a number of somebody who can actually help with the problem. I would give you now -5 stars.
